newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 1c to 622c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 1c to 622c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator eased one cent to 622 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece of 19 microns was slightly dearer, and 20-25m 0.5 percent cheaper, while merino skirtings were mostly unchanged, it said.
In crossbreds, 26m was unchanged, 27m slightly dearer, 28m 0.5 percent cheaper, 29m one percent dearer, 30m 0.5 percent dearer and 31m one percent cheaper.
In cardings, lambs were fully firm, carbonising locks slightly cheaper and crutchings unchanged.
WI said Japanese interests, China and Western Europe were principal buyers with good support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 24,488 bales offered, 12 percent were passed in.
Sales continue Thursday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 44,300 bales to be offered.
